# DO NOT DOWNLOAD - Development Build

**For normal use, download the [latest stable release](https://github.com/Ode1l/NX-Cast/releases/latest) instead.**

**普通用户请勿下载此开发版，请使用[最新正式版本](https://github.com/Ode1l/NX-Cast/releases/latest)。**

Continuous is an automatically updated development build, not a stable release. It may contain unfinished changes or regressions. Download it only when a maintainer explicitly asks you to test a specific build.

Continuous 是自动更新的开发测试版，不是正式版本，可能包含未完成的改动或功能回退。仅在维护者明确要求测试指定构建时下载。

The version shown inside the app can match a stable release; identify this build by the `continuous` download page and commit below, not the app version alone.

软件内显示的版本号可能与正式版相同；请以 `continuous` 下载页面及下方提交编号识别构建，不要仅凭软件版本号判断。
